## Checklist

Before submitting your PR, please review the following checklist:

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation

### Testing
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have checked that my changes don't break existing functionality

### Responsive Design
- [ ] I have tested my changes on mobile devices
- [ ] I have used responsive design principles and media queries where appropriate
- [ ] Text sizes scale appropriately across different screen sizes

### Performance
- [ ] I have considered the performance impact of my changes
- [ ] I have optimized images and assets where applicable
- [ ] I have minimized bundle size impact

### Accessibility
- [ ] I have considered accessibility implications
- [ ] I have added appropriate ARIA labels where needed
- [ ] I have tested with keyboard navigation

### Browser Compatibility
- [ ] I have tested my changes in multiple browsers
- [ ] I have checked for cross-browser compatibility issues
